quality.measurementPolicy: Travel counts outbound and return home legs plus chronological school transitions per instructor/date, verified routes only; unknown legs counted separately. Availability is union of explicit windows with date exceptions over requested period, excluding unpermitted Friday; sector-specific holidays and travel are not subtracted from the availability denominator. Free windows are raw gaps, not certified course placements.

audit.scope: Independent arithmetic audit. Course restriction/employment semantics and approved exceptions require additional contract checks; protected-source findings are not newly introduced engine changes.
